QAAgentTrainer.docstring: Trains Q&A agents on question-answer pairs.

Trains conversation agents on user-assistant pairs.

Learns your conversation style, response patterns, and interaction preferences.

Integrated ingester that processes conversations immediately.

Features:

- LLM summarization during storage
- Embedding generation
- IP resurrection extraction

- Training dataset generation for AI agents

- Security and authentication

- Model management
